contracts.before_after: Before: v2.13.1 is invoked with the same five inputs in all three jobs. After: v2.16.1 is invoked with the same inputs in all three jobs; the workflow file itself does not change the inputs.
contracts.visible_effect: None for the product; this is CI only. A CI run either starts Minikube with the pinned MINIKUBE_VERSION and KUBERNETES_VERSION or fails.

The action's action.yml at v2.16.1 is not in this repository and I could not fetch it in this read-only review, so I could not confirm the input names.

summary: Reviewed .github/workflows/operator-ci.yml in full. The diff is a Dependabot bump of manusa/actions-setup-minikube from v2.13.1 to v2.16.1 in the three Minikube setup steps (test-local, test-remote, test-olm). The change is limited to CI and touches no product code. The tag pinning matches the rest of the workflow (actions/checkout@v4, actions/download-artifact@v4), and no workflow in .github pins by SHA, so I raised no finding on that. I could not read the action's action.yml at v2.16.1 or its release notes from this read-only environment, so whether its inputs are unchanged is recorded as an open contract rather than a finding. I raised no findings.
